[[Yorik Warblade]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for items.

==Locations==
*[[Southern Shiverpeaks]]
**{{NPC location|Snake Dance}}

==Dialogue==
:''"I'm searching for 1 [[Emboldened Carapace Shield]]. I can offer you one of the following items in exchange. Can you help me?"''

==Collector items==
{{:Yorik Warblade/Collector}}

==Notes==
*This collector was added ([[Game updates/20060714|update of July 14, 2006]]) as a way to rectify an error that changed the stats of all Emboldened Carapace Shields, by allowing an exchange of an old shield for a corrected shield.
